{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the `revenue` column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_sales = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Check the number of real orders
print(f"Number of real orders after removing QA: {len(real_sales)}")

# Compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = real_sales.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print results
print("\nTotal revenue by channel:")
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Identify the channel with the most revenue
max_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
max_revenue = revenue_by_channel.max()

print(f"\nChannel with the most revenue: {max_channel} ({max_revenue:,.2f})")"}
